intro: Ethiopia is a federal parliamentary republic of regions organised mostly along ethnic lines.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The prime minister, Abiy Ahmed since 2018, leads the government. The president is ceremonial. Regional states have wide powers.

chapters.title: Conflict
text: Armed conflict has continued in Amhara and Oromia regions.

keyTerms.meaning: Power shared between national and regional governments.
